profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at DSI
profile.summary:
Architect and designing software solutions in a .NET environment.

Specialties: .NET, C#, VB.NET, SQL Server, XML, ASP.NET, C++, Java,Android

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of high-performance telemetry system to collect and analyze data. Developing web applications both public and internal using .NET Core, Angular, jQuery, Bootstrap. Integrate Ldap and Azure Active Directory authentication, along with JWT.  Designing web API for interop with desktop apps, also architecting the system to use dependency injection, modular, domain driven design.  Migrated an on-premise TFS 2017 to Azure DevOps Services online, using full fidelity migration, updated Team process template to use inherited Scrum process with some customizations. Building and upgrading TFS / Azure DevOps build pipelines and build servers with simplified package management using Chocolatey. Integrating legacy C++ and modern C# WPF codebase. Removed problematic third party SSDP component and developed replacement. Designing cloud SaaS solution with .Net Core, REST web services API, Azure SQL, Azure Active Directory, blob storage, with multi-tenant database design and row-level security. Designing system for fast visualization and retrieval of multi-gigabyte data. Training and mentoring junior developers, code reviews, updating branching strategies.
positions.insights: Skills: Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · ASP.NET Razor · ASP.NET Web API · Web Services · Agile Software Development · JavaScript · Bootstrap (Framework) · Angular

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing and architecting a system of software products and components for GE Security home security systems later acquired by UTC Fire and Security.  
Conducting code reviews, training sessions, and mentoring junior team members.  Ensuring all components and processes work together as a complete solution for a user on a single computer, a distributed multi-user enterprise environment and everything in between.
SQL database design, development, and optimization.
Also developing cloud solutions with Microsoft Azure, Web API, REST servers.  Designing Android app to connect through cloud servers to control cloud connected panel.  Investigating NFC, 6LoWPAN technologies to integrate with exiting systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full life cycle project development with Siebel CRM software.  Defining requirements, software design and development using required standards and guidlines.  Working with the Customer Service department and providing technical leadership for implementing OO design patterns and improving security procedures.
Mentoring team members and presenting informal training sessions.
Working with Visual Basic, Siebel, Oracle, UNIX scripting, autosys job scheduling.  Developing COM+ package for integrating AS400 and Siebel.

positions.title: Information Technology Consultant
positions.description: Performing consulting and software engineering for client companies.   Specializing in .NET, SQL Server, VB, C++, DCOM, MTS.  N-tier application development.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Developing leading edge computerized testing software.  Programming in Visual Basic 4-5, Win API, C and SQL.
- Primary developer responsible for production of retail educational software and creating installation for suite of programs.  
- Developed a distributed online testing system and tutorial system.
